bastion-developer-for-devtest.title: The free Bastion Developer SKU may be enough for dev/test
bastion-developer-for-devtest.body: This non-production estimate pays for a dedicated Bastion host. Microsoft recommends the free Developer SKU for individual dev/test use where you do not need concurrent connections or advanced features.

citation.quote: Bastion Developer is free and perfect for dev/test workloads, eliminating costs entirely for these environments.

bastion-hub-based-fewer-hosts.title: Fewer Bastion hosts may do the job
bastion-hub-based-fewer-hosts.body: This estimate deploys several Bastion hosts and each bills hourly. A hub-and-spoke design with one Bastion in the hub can reach peered networks, which reduces the number of hosts you pay for.

citation.quote: Hub-based deployment reduces the total number of Bastion resources needed.

bastion-start-basic.title: Is Standard needed, or is Basic enough?
bastion-start-basic.body: This production estimate uses Standard with no extra instances. Microsoft suggests starting with Basic unless you need Standard features such as native client, file transfer or shareable links; Basic costs less per hour.

citation.quote: Start with Basic SKU for production environments unless advanced features are required.
